months.note: 봄과 가을에 적은 수가 한반도를 지나가며, 번식지에서는 5월 하순~7월 상순에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 봄과 가을에 적은 수가 한반도를 지나가는 새이다. 혼자 또는 암수가 함께 주로 땅 위에서 지낸다. 초원에서 번식하며 돌 밑, 어린 침엽수, 숲속 나무뿌리 가까이, 바퀴 자국이 깊게 팬 곳 등에 둥지를 틀고, 한배에 알을 4~5개, 때로 6개 낳는다.

art.subject: Blyth's Pipit (Anthus godlewskii), adult in spring, sexes alike, as seen on migration in Korea in May: crown and back buff-brown, every feather with a bold blackish centre, giving a boldly streaked lark-like look; median coverts with square-ended black centres and broad pale buff tips; white lores and a buff supercilium; buff-brown cheeks and ear coverts outlined by a thin dark line; whitish throat; broken blackish malar stripe; breast buff with a narrow band of fine, short dark brown streaks across the lower throat and upper breast; flanks warm buff and almost unstreaked, belly and undertail coverts whitish; brown upper mandible, yellowish lower mandible with a dark tip; brown iris; pale pinkish legs.
art.pose: walking alone on open ground, side view
art.scene: Korean spring migration: open grassland with short turf and scattered stones; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view walking on the ground: buff-brown upperparts boldly streaked black, square-centred black median coverts with buff tips, whitish throat and belly, buff breast with a narrow band of fine brown streaks, plain buff flanks, pale pinkish legs

adult, head detail in profile: white lores, buff supercilium, buff ear coverts outlined by a thin dark line, broken blackish malar stripe, pointed bill with brown upper and yellowish lower mandible tipped dark
art.build: Medium-large pipit, clearly longer than a sparrow and slimmer; smaller and more compact than Richard's Pipit, with a shorter tail, shorter legs and a less upright stance. Bill straight, pointed, fairly slender, shorter than the head. Legs medium length, pale pinkish; hind claw short and arched, about as long as the hind toe. At rest the long tertials almost cover the primaries. Tail medium length, dark brown with white outer feathers. Walks on the ground and flies off with a bounding flight.
avoid: Do not paint a long heavy bill, very long legs, a long straight hind claw and a very upright posture; those are Richard's Pipit (Anthus richardi).
Do not paint olive-green upperparts or a white-and-black spot on the ear coverts (Olive-backed Pipit, Anthus hodgsoni).
Do not paint heavy black streaks running down the flanks or white stripes on the back (Pechora Pipit, Anthus gustavi).
Do not paint plain, unstreaked upperparts; the back is boldly streaked.
